title: The 8 Best Bench Clamps for Woodworking 2026
h1: The 8 Best Bench Clamps for Woodworking 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for bench clamps for woodworking 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at bench clamps for woodworking 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: POWERTEC 8-Inch Hold Fast Clamps for 3/4-Inch Bench Dog Hole, 2-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: Traditional holdfast design, Ductile iron body, Fits 3/4-inch bench dog holes.
strengths: Traditional holdfast locks with a single mallet blow to the post -- faster than any screw clamp
Ductile iron body transmits the holding force to the bench with no mechanical adjustment
Releases instantly with a mallet blow to the side of the post
A fast way to secure a workpiece for hand planing, chiseling, and carving
limitations: Requires a thick bench top (minimum 1.5-3 inches) for the lever arm action to work
Does not work well in thin bench tops or MDF bench tops
Learning the setting technique takes a session or two
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: POWERTEC 71466 Bench Dog Clamps, 3/4-Inch Dog Hole (2-Pack)
products.blurb: Key specs: Works with 3/4-inch bench dog holes, Spring-loaded aluminum alloy body, Crosshatched clamping face.
strengths: Fits standard 3/4-inch bench dog holes and holds workpieces against the bench surface
Crosshatched face grips workpieces securely during clamping
Works in combination with the face vise to hold panels flat on the bench
Aluminum alloy body keeps the clamp light while still delivering solid holding force
limitations: Spring-loaded action offers less range than a holdfast
Requires bench dog holes spaced at standard intervals
features: 2-degree negative slope for downward clamping force

products.name: POWERTEC 71467 Solid Steel Bench Dog
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits standard 3/4-inch bench dog holes, Powder-coated solid steel, Compact, no moving parts.
strengths: Solid steel construction survives repeated planing impact without deforming
Works as a stop for holding a board edge while the vise handles the end
The most compact and lowest-cost dog-hole accessory in this lineup
Powder coating resists rust better than bare steel bench dogs
limitations: No spring-loaded pop-up -- must be lifted out manually
Works best for light repositioning work rather than heavy hand planing
features: For holding panels against the face vise

products.name: Rockler Bench Cookie Work Grippers, 4-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: High-friction, non-marring rubber surface, Elevates workpiece, For routing, sanding, finishing.
strengths: Elevates the workpiece above the bench surface for routing edges -- allows the router to hang over the bench
Non-slip rubber surface holds the workpiece without clamps during routing and sanding
Grips through sawdust buildup for a consistently stable base
The most versatile bench-top accessory for routing, sanding, and finishing small panels
limitations: No mechanical holding -- non-slip only. Will not hold against strong lateral forces
Not appropriate for heavy hand planing work

products.name: POWERTEC 71528 8-Inch Workbench Holdfast, 2-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: Two holdfasts for holding stock at both ends, Fits 3/4-inch bench dog holes, Grey powder-coated finish.
strengths: Two holdfasts let you secure both ends of a long board simultaneously
Works across a wider range of bench top thicknesses than most single holdfasts
Same fast mallet-set, mallet-release action as a single holdfast
Buying a matched pair costs less per unit than two single holdfasts
limitations: Still requires drilled 3/4-inch dog holes at the right spacing for both holdfasts
Thin bench tops reduce holding force
features: Two holdfasts for holding stock at both ends

products.name: Bessey BS6N Hold Down Table Clamp
products.blurb: Key specs: Cam-action lever clamp, Clamps to bench edge, no dog holes required, 500mm reach / 140mm throat.
strengths: Clamps directly to the bench edge -- works on benches without dog holes or T-tracks, including a Moxon-style front apron
Cam lever locks and releases instantly with one hand
Long reach handles wide panels and elevated jigs like a Moxon vise jaw
Bessey's cam-clamp mechanism is proven in production shops for repeatable clamping force
limitations: Requires a bench edge or jig with enough thickness to grip
Single clamp -- pairs of these are needed for even, twin-point clamping like a true Moxon vise
features: Clamps to bench edge, no dog holes required

products.name: BESSEY RiteHite Hold Down Clamp, 1000L
products.blurb: Key specs: Self-positioning cam design, T-slot mounting, Steel and ductile iron construction.
strengths: Self-positioning design makes it easy to install and adjust in a T-slot
T-slot mounting works in router table tracks and bench T-tracks
Ductile iron and steel construction holds up to repeated clamping cycles
Bessey is the professional clamp brand -- quality is consistent
limitations: Requires a T-slot track mounted in the bench or router table
Lower holding force than a holdfast for heavy planing
features: For bench, router table, and machine tables

products.name: POWERTEC 71207 Non-Slip Router Mat, Roll-Up Rubber Workbench Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: Non-slip rubber grid surface, Protects bench top, Lightweight, roll-up design.
strengths: Non-slip surface holds workpieces during chiseling, carving, and small routing operations
Protects the bench surface from scratches and finish damage
Repositionable without any mounting -- move to any part of the bench instantly
The lowest-cost bench clamping solution -- correct for light operations that do not require mechanical clamping
limitations: No mechanical clamping -- will not hold against heavy hand planing
Surface can pick up shavings that reduce non-slip effectiveness

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
